content.text: In Zimbabwe, digital creators face a stark reality: global payment platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-which-architecture-actually-works-7|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] and PayPal are inaccessible. This isn’t a temporary glitch—it’s a systemic lock-out. Your ability to sell digital products hinges on infrastructure you control. Supabase, paired with Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, becomes your order database and payment processor. This stack eliminates platform dependency. You own the code. You own the data. You own the revenue stream. No subscriptions. No shutdowns. No geographic restrictions. This is sovereign commerce infrastructure—built to withstand the very rejection you’ve faced. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-google-apps-script-digital-commerce-12|The Real]]-behind-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-4|architecture]] in 48 hours. Here’s how it works.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail because they centralize control. Stripe rejects you based on location, not merit. PayPal freezes accounts without warning. These systems are designed for compliance, not for creators in markets deemed ‘high-risk.’ Supabase, Cloudflare, and NOWPayments invert this model. Supabase acts as your order database—a PostgreSQL instance you control. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, ensuring no single point of failure. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. This stack is decentralized by design. It runs on infrastructure you own or on services with clear, transparent terms. When you deploy the Edge Commerce Stack, you’re not renting a platform—you’re building a system. Your store operates on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, free and globally accessible. Orders are stored in Supabase, not on a third-party server. Payments are verified on-chain, not through a centralized gateway. This architecture doesn’t ask permission. It operates because you built it.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, ensure you have your digital products ready—ebooks, courses, templates, or software. Organize them in a Google Drive folder or Cloudflare R2 bucket for instant delivery. Next, set up a NOWPayments account. Choose BSC, Solana, or TRON for transaction fees under $0.10. Create a Supabase project to store orders. You’ll need a Cloudflare account for Workers and Pages. If you opt for GitHub Pages, ensure your repository is public. Prepare your product descriptions, pricing, and metadata. Test your payment flow locally before going live. The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30 days of support, but you should familiarize yourself with the components. Understand how Supabase tables map to orders, how Cloudflare Workers handle webhooks, and how NOWPayments verifies transactions. This isn’t a plugin—it’s infrastructure. Treat it with the respect it deserves.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with the backend. Deploy Cloudflare Workers to handle order creation and payment verification. Configure NOWPayments to send webhooks to your Worker when a transaction confirms. Map the payment data to a Supabase table. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate file delivery. When an order is marked as paid, trigger a download link sent via email or generated on your storefront. Test this pipeline with testnet transactions before going live. Ensure the Supabase table logs every order, the Worker processes every webhook, and the file delivery system works flawlessly. The Edge Commerce Stack includes end-to-end testing, but you should verify each step manually. This pipeline is your revenue engine. Every component must function without error.
Supabase gives you full control over your order data—no platform can shut it down.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Point your domain to the live URL. Promote your products through social media, email, or direct links. When a customer pays, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and sends a webhook to your Worker. The Worker updates the Supabase order table and triggers file delivery. Monitor your Supabase dashboard for new orders. Check your NOWPayments account for transaction confirmations. Your first live transaction proves the infrastructure works. Document the process for future reference. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration to ensure your emails land in inboxes, not spam folders. This isn’t a launch—it’s a deployment. Treat it as such.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once live, optimize for scale. Monitor Supabase query performance and add indexes as needed. Upgrade to a paid Supabase tier if your order volume increases. Use Cloudflare’s edge network to cache static assets and reduce latency. Add more products to your store by updating the Supabase table and frontend catalog. Integrate additional payment networks through NOWPayments to offer customers more options. The Edge Commerce Stack includes a scaling playbook, but the principles are straightforward: own your data, control your costs, and eliminate single points of failure. This infrastructure isn’t just for survival—it’s for growth. You’re not building a store; you’re building a system that outlasts platforms.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Supabase serves as your order database, storing every transaction in a PostgreSQL instance you control. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, processing payments and triggering file delivery. NOWPayments verifies crypto transactions on-chain, sending webhooks to your Worker. This stack eliminates platform dependency, giving you full data ownership and revenue control. Deploy the Edge Commerce Stack to get this architecture live in 48 hours.
Cloudflare Workers ensure your backend logic runs globally with zero server management.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this Supabase-powered infrastructure in 48 hours. It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase setup, NOWPayments integration, and end-to-end testing. You get a fully operational digital store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant file delivery. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. Lifetime access. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to deploy.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Prepare your digital products and organize them in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 2. Set up a NOWPayments account and select a low-fee network like BSC or Solana. 3. Create a Supabase project and design your order table schema. 4. Deploy Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing and payment verification. 5. Configure NOWPayments webhooks to trigger your Worker. 6. Test the payment pipeline with testnet transactions. 7. Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 8. Point your domain to the live URL and promote your products. 9. Monitor Supabase and NOWPayments for live transactions. 10. Optimize for scale by adding indexes, caching assets, and integrating more payment networks.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use Supabase for free?
Yes, Supabase offers a free tier with 500MB of storage and 50k row reads/writes per month. Upgrade as your store scales.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and stablecoins on BSC, Solana, and TRON for low fees.
Do I need to write code to deploy this stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack includes pre-built templates, but basic familiarity with JavaScript and APIs is recommended for customization.
How are files delivered to customers?
Files are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. A download link is automatically generated and sent to the customer upon payment confirmation.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates on decentralized networks. If their service fails, transactions still confirm on-chain. Your Worker can retry webhook processing later.
NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and no buyer KYC required.
